sources.title: DAGGER: Distractor-Aware Graph Generation for Executable Reasoning
sources.snippet: We present DAGGER, a framework that reformulates mathematical reasoning as computational graph generation with explicit distractor modeling. Achieves 89% fewer tokens than reasoning models while maintaining comparable accuracy.
